verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community post quoting Morph's privacy policy. Per that quote, Free Tier code data may be used for training, while the Enterprise Tier uses submitted data only to process the immediate request. So keeping data out of training appears to depend on buying Enterprise rather than a user-controlled opt-out, and the user asking for clarification suggests paid non-enterprise tiers may be trained on. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a training opt-out, a self-serve no-training setting for all tiers, clarity on paid non-enterprise tiers, and independent confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Enterprise Tier: We do not use your submitted code data for any purpose other than processing your immediate request.
